name: Claudius Ptolemy
summary: Greek mathematician, astronomer, and geographer active in Roman Alexandria during the 2nd century CE.

name: Syrus
summary: Dedicatee of half of Ptolemy's extant works, likely a patron or student in Alexandria.

name: Alexandria
summary: Capital city of Egypt and center of Ptolemy's intellectual activity.

name: Canopus
summary: Town near Alexandria where Ptolemy erected his astronomical inscription.

name: Temple of Serapis
summary: Temple in Canopus where the Canobic Inscription was set up.

name: Antoninus Pius
summary: Roman Emperor whose tenth regnal year dates the Canobic Inscription.

name: Canobic Inscription
summary: Astronomical stele erected by Ptolemy in 147/148 CE containing planetary models and harmonic theory.

name: Almagest
summary: Ptolemy's major astronomical treatise, written after the Canobic Inscription.

name: Harmonics
summary: Ptolemy's treatise on music theory and harmonic intervals.

name: Universitat de Barcelona
summary: University where the source thesis was submitted.
